name: chatMessenger
title: Chat Messenger
description: Short synthetic Messenger-style conversation when a back-and-forth helps explain a use case, objection, or punchline. Use sparingly because it is long.

vanillasky.useWhen: Short synthetic Messenger-style conversation when a back-and-forth helps explain a use case, objection, or punchline. Use sparingly because it is long.

msg1.label: Message 1 (received)
msg1.description: First message — left/received by default. Append |in or |out to override side. Aim for 3-4 messages total; use 5 with date chips only for a real time gap in a 10s+ scene.

msg2.label: Message 2 (received or sent)
msg2.default: It saves me hours every week
msg2.description: Second message — left/received by default. Override with |out for ping-pong.

msg3.label: Message 3 (received)
msg3.description: Third message — left/received by default. Leave blank for a two-message exchange.

msg4.label: Message 4 (sent)
msg4.description: Fourth message — right/sent by default. Optional; most chats end here.

dateChip1.label: Date chip 1
dateChip1.description: Optional date label before message 4. Use only for a real time gap.

dateChip2.label: Date chip 2
dateChip2.description: Optional date label before message 5. Use only for a real time gap.

msg5.label: Message 5 (sent)
msg5.description: Optional fifth message — right/sent by default.

defaultVariables.msg2: It saves me hours every week
